release.notes: Dashboard captions and the charging card follow the app language; cold battery modules shown grey-blue; the Battery Test 100→0% certificate shows the test's VIN; stricter communication check and tighter PDF in the pre-purchase check; Remote Tuning accepts more reference values (VIN, odometer, temperatures, fault-code text); Android Auto: optional AVG SPEED tile (new, please check); repeated CAN error warning; debug mode by 6 taps on the version; new or better readings for Tesla Model 3/Y, Hyundai/Kia, Renault ZOE, XPeng P7+, Jeep Avenger.
